ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-17-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Nici Rodich.
Petitioner: Mei Wu Zhen, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Mei Ping Wu.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-26-2006 Reset To Oct-17-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Petitioner: Mei Wu Zhen, present in pro per without the attorney of record: Clifford Y. Wang, and no proof of publication.
Matter is continued to Oct. 12, 2006 at 9:00 A.M. for appearance of counsel and for Petitioner to file the Proof of Publication with the court.
